name: c2d-empty-pec-box-ringdown
origin: MEEPhistopheles src/metal/dipole_s11.swift, plane k = 64. Its kernels have no z-derivatives (Ez, Hx, Hy only), so each z-plane is an independent 2-D TM problem and the recorded runs drive only the feed plane. The program runs 64 x 64 cells per plane and holds Ez at nodes 0 and 63: the (N-1) dx box. Its source is the 5 x 5 soft Ez patch at x 0.5 around (32, 32). Ring-down version (32,000 steps, envelope 0.5 periods), as examples/yee-dispersion.
